recipes.title: Tomato and Egg Breakfast Sandwich
recipes.summary: Golden toast sandwiches tender scrambled eggs and juicy tomato slices for a satisfying breakfast.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Pat the tomato slices dry with a paper towel.
Whisk the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Add the eggs and gently stir for 3–4 minutes until set with no liquid egg remaining.
Layer the eggs and tomato between the toast slices and serve immediately.
substitutions: Replace the bread with vegetarian English muffins.
Use halved cherry tomatoes instead of sliced tomato.
tips: Dry the tomato well to keep the toast crisp.
Keep the heat low so the eggs stay tender.

recipes.title: Skillet Tomato Eggs with Toast Soldiers
recipes.summary: Eggs nestle in a quick garlicky tomato sauce alongside crisp toast strips for dipping.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic if using and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, salt, and pepper and simmer for 6–7 minutes, crushing the tomatoes with a spoon.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 6–8 minutes until the whites and yolks are set.
Toast the bread while the eggs cook and cut it into strips.
Divide the eggs and sauce between plates and serve with the toast strips.
substitutions: Replace the fresh tomatoes with one 14-ounce can of crushed tomatoes.
Use gluten-free bread instead of wheat bread.
tips: Use a 10- or 12-inch skillet so the eggs have room.
Add a tablespoon of water if the sauce dries out before the eggs set.

recipes.title: Savory Tomato French Toast
recipes.summary: Peppery egg-soaked bread fries golden and crisp beneath a warm topping of juicy tomatoes.
steps: Whisk the eggs, water, pepper, and half the salt in a shallow dish.
Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Cook the tomatoes with the remaining salt for 3 minutes, then transfer to a bowl.
Dip two bread slices in the egg mixture for 10 seconds per side.
Heat half the remaining oil and fry the soaked bread for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and the egg coating is fully set.
Repeat with the remaining bread and oil, discarding any leftover raw egg mixture.
Top the French toast with the warm tomatoes and basil if using.
substitutions: Use stale baguette slices instead of sandwich bread.
tips: Use slightly stale bread to avoid a soggy center.
Keep the first batch on a warm plate while cooking the second.
